strength.label: Useful equipment
strength.text: Motion lists a 360-degree camera, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring as standard.

tradeoff.label: AC charging target
tradeoff.text: Motion's 7 kW AC system has a 6.5-hour 10–100% charging target under Suzuki's room-temperature development conditions.

conditions: e VITARA Motion FWD 49kWh is a Suzuki Australia catalogue configuration checked 10 October 2026; excludes Queensland and Northern NSW.
Manufacturer MY, factory-build applicability, current order acceptance, physical stock and delivery timing are unverified; current catalogue facts remain source-scoped.

Suzuki in-house room-temperature development target with suitable compatible charging equipment; actual time varies with ambient and battery temperature, battery condition and age, and can increase in cold weather or battery safeguarding.
Current price is unknown: the displayed first-100-orders introductory offer required an order before 30 September 2026, and no extension was verified.

strength.label: Useful equipment
